syntheticTools.name: update_plan
syntheticTools.description: Replaces the current turn's durable task/plan event in the Session store.

syntheticTools.name: read_tool_result
syntheticTools.description: Reads bounded UTF-8 pages from a redacted tool-result artifact stored in Session artifacts.

syntheticTools.name: skill
syntheticTools.description: Loads an observed workspace Skill into the Session prompt surface without granting execution authority.

syntheticTools.name: ask_user_question
syntheticTools.description: Pauses the root Session at a durable question barrier until the user responds.

syntheticTools.name: request_user_action
syntheticTools.description: Pauses the root Session for external user action with explicit completion verification.

syntheticTools.name: spawn_one_shot_agent
syntheticTools.description: Spawns a single-turn subagent child Session within parent/role capability bounds.

syntheticTools.name: spawn_continuable_agent
syntheticTools.description: Spawns a multi-turn continuable subagent child Session within parent/role capability bounds.

syntheticTools.name: send_child_input
syntheticTools.description: Delivers follow-up input to an existing continuable subagent child Session.

syntheticTools.name: retry_child_agent
syntheticTools.description: Recovers a failed continuable subagent in its original Session under its remaining budget.

syntheticTools.name: inspect_child_agent
syntheticTools.description: Returns the durable snapshot, continuation state, and failure recovery status of a child Session.

syntheticTools.name: cancel_child_agent
syntheticTools.description: Cancels an active subagent child Session and drains its in-flight execution.

syntheticTools.name: fleet_plan
syntheticTools.description: Creates a durable multi-target Fleet rollout plan owned by the Session scheduler.

syntheticTools.name: fleet_start
syntheticTools.description: Starts execution of a planned Fleet rollout across canary and wave stages.

syntheticTools.name: fleet_pause
syntheticTools.description: Pauses dispatching further Fleet waves while letting active workers settle.

syntheticTools.name: fleet_resume
syntheticTools.description: Resumes a paused Fleet rollout scheduler from its durable state.

syntheticTools.name: fleet_abort
syntheticTools.description: Aborts a Fleet rollout and cancels its registered child Sessions.

syntheticTools.name: fleet_reconcile
syntheticTools.description: Records explicit reconciliation evidence for an uncertain Fleet target.

modelFacades.name: run_terminal_command
modelFacades.description: Model-facing command facade translated by native_adapter to exec_command (direct surface) or terminal_execute (boundTerminal surface).

modelFacades.name: write_process_input
modelFacades.description: Model-facing process stdin facade translated by native_adapter to the native write_stdin tool on a bound process handle.

modelFacades.name: call_mcp_tool
modelFacades.description: Model-facing dynamic MCP facade translated by native_adapter to native MCP server/tool capability preparation and execution.
